hooks.text: 与腌菜帮策划荒诞银行劫案，威吓人质并洗劫植物银行
hooks.excerpt: This time the career criminal is teaming up with the fearsome Pickled Gang to plan and execute the weirdest heist of all time! Shake down hostages, steal precious valuables, and explore the deep, dark depths and history of the Botanical Bank.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 用古怪武器与保安和精英蔬菜特警展开高强度枪战
hooks.excerpt: An array of wacky weapons! Take on whoever the bank throws at you in intense shootouts, from security guards to elite veggie swat teams!
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 收集可穿戴帽子和新歌，同时揭开萝卜男孩世界的深层历史
hooks.excerpt: Earn collectable hats to wear, new banger tracks to blast, and discover a deeper history of Turnip Boy’s world and how it came to be!
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
